newsitem.title: USA: Synergy Media says Mau named CEO.
newsitem.headline: Synergy Media says Mau named CEO.

text.p: Synergy Media Inc said on Tuesday that Paula Mau has been named chief executive officer, replacing Suchindran Chatterjee, who resigned in late September.
Mau was head of a business unit at U S West Communications Group, Synergy said.

"Synergy needed an individual who understands the competitive nature of the communications market," said chairman Michael Luther in a news release. "Along with her market analysis and strategic business planning success with US West Communications, Ms. Mau brings a solid background in additional key business disciplines."
